about: Sense without features (types/0x0030-sense.md; zadania/zrobione/FEAT-13.md): profile env, ep4 TEMPERATURE (i16, 0.01 °C), ep5 HUMIDITY (u16, 0.01 %). Value is absent until the first measurement and not reported before it (§5.5); a measurement goes out at once; a change below the quantity's default hysteresis — 0.20 °C, 1.00 % — stays quiet, one at it is reported against the last REPORTED value (§5.3); the cycle of 60 s carries the value unchanged; a failed reading is reported as absent and the next good one is a change (§5.2). The defaults are readable as the common ReportHysteresis and ReportInterval. A measurement step is `sense`: endpoint → raw value, null for a failed reading.

steps.note: before any measurement Value is absent
the default hysteresis of a temperature: 0.20 °C
the first measurement: 21.50 °C and 45.00 %, out at once
the cycle carries the values unchanged
back: a value after absent is a change
